items.title: Shark fins for kendu leaves: Seven arrested in sea exchange off Chilaw
items.summary: Four Sri Lankan fishermen and three Indian fishermen were arrested after the Sri Lanka Coast Guard and Navy intercepted an illegal exchange of shark fins and kendu leaves at sea off Chilaw on November 26.

items.title: Non availability of sanitary pads in local prisons could turn into a major health hazard soon: MP
items.summary: Non availability of sanitary pads for female prisoners in Sri Lanka could be a major health hazard soon if it is not addressed, an MP told Parliament yesterday.

items.title: 13-year-old schoolgirl dies after falling from milk lorry
items.summary: A 13-year-old schoolgirl died after falling from a milk-collecting lorry while travelling home following a Christmas carol rehearsal in Norwood yesterday, police said.

items.title: Public service shrinks, but salary bill keeps rising
items.summary: Sri Lanka’s public service lost more than 23,000 employees in the year to June 2026, and vacancies rose to 236,967, yet the state’s salary bill kept climbing, official figures show.
